_comment: PROVENANCE: this is a documented-shape SAMPLE, not a live capture. It was assembled by hand on
2026-09-15 from the published response shapes, not recorded from a real mainnet call:
`getTokenAccountsByOwnerV2` answers `{ accounts: [{ pubkey, account }], paginationKey }` and
`getAccountInfo` answers `{ context, value }`, both as documented for the Helius RPC; with
`encoding: 'jsonParsed'` a Token-2022 account carries `account.data.parsed.info` and a Token-2022
mint carries its extensions as `info.extensions[]`, each `{ extension, state }` - the two the
Seeker check reads are named `metadataPointer` and `tokenGroupMember`.
The three values the check compares against (the Genesis Token's mint authority and the
collection address its metadata pointer and token group both name) come from the Solana Mobile
documentation for engaging Seeker users, not from this fixture's own sample data.
METADATA_ADDRESS, GROUP_ADDRESS) are resolved by test/helpers/heliusFixture.js.
Fields no production code reads (lamports, space, rentEpoch, the tokenMetadata extension, ...)
are kept only so the fixture looks like what the RPC actually returns.
